title: Fallback coverage lacuna inventory (cross-team rollup)
summary: One-off reconciliation sheet to call out small coverage gaps (lacunae) in fallback behavior across product routes and regional deployments. Intended for a quick sync with SRE, Serving Runtime, and Product to prioritize immediate fixes or accept risk for the next 2-week window.
notes:
Context: post-incident quick audit flagged a few routes that report but don't actually trigger model variant fallback in low-capacity windows. This is lightweight — rows are action-oriented and include last verification and next owner action. Keep informal; intended to be exported to short meeting slides.

Quick rules: (1) list a gap only if it can be verified end-to-end in <30m; (2) mark "accept risk" only with explicit exec/PM signoff in comments; (3) include ticket links where possible.

Open questions: who owns regional testing for dedicated pools? (SRE/Platform?)  -- tag at sync.
rows: Service: chat-generation | Owner: Arjun Patel | Fallback: model-variant -> smaller-quantized | Coverage gap: doesn't switch when GPU pool drained for 30s | Last test: 2029-10-28 (smoke) | Next action: add circuit-breaker + unit test | Blocking ticket: OPS-1123

Service: embeddings-batch | Owner: Zoe Hart | Fallback: route-to-CPU-embedder | Coverage gap: batch path bypasses fallback if batch size >1000 | Last test: 2029-10-30 (dev) | Next action: add batching guard + alert | Blocking ticket: ENG-3210
